notes: Fixes the subtitle "Too many requests" error. Each time you picked a subtitle the player was re-downloading every subtitle you had tried before it, so browsing a few of them fired off a burst of downloads and the addon blocked you - and its refusal message was what you saw on screen as the subtitle. Now each pick downloads exactly one file, and re-picking the same one downloads nothing. Subtitles also no longer carry over to the next episode. Seeking recovers roughly three times faster too.
